ACQSTATUS returns ACQUIRED, ACQUIRING, RELEASED or RELEASING. ACQUIRED means ACB open and set-logon-start complete; RELEASED means connections unbound and ACB closed. Persistently transitional states may require operator VTAM action [primary parser lines 20-33].

INSTLSTATUS is INSTALLED or NOTINSTALLED (discarding but still in use). SERVSTATUS is INSERVICE, OUTSERVICE or GOINGOUT (out-of-service requested but conversation still uses the node). USERDATA is 64 characters; unset returns null characters.
